title: Colour season finder: your palette from one selfie
description: Free colour season finder for Indian skin. Upload one selfie in daylight and get your season, undertone and a palette to shop from.
headline: Find your colour season from one selfie
sub: One selfie in daylight. Your season, your palette. Free.
how_it_works: Pick your door and answer five quick questions about your life, climate, occasions, budget and vibe.
Take one selfie near a window, or upload one. No filter, no heavy make-up.
Get your season, your undertone, three things that are working for you and a palette of colours to buy.
what_you_get: Your colour season: spring, summer, autumn or winter, with a depth such as light, true, soft, bright or deep.
Your undertone: warm, cool or neutral, with a plain note on how confident the read is.
Three things that are working for you, each tied to something visible in your photo.
One thing to stop buying, phrased as an upgrade.
A palette of six to eight colours you can shop from today, plus a share card without your photo.

working_for_you: Your warm, golden-brown skin glows next to olive and rust.
Your dark hair and strong brows give you natural contrast, so deep colours look rich on you.
Your jawline holds a collared shirt well.
sample.stop_buying: Swap the stark white shirts for cream. Cream sits better against your warm skin.

faq.q: How accurate is a selfie colour analysis?
faq.a: It is a strong guide, not a lab test. Light matters most, so the tool shows how confident it is and asks for a retake in daylight when the photo is not clear enough.
We read it once to find your colours and delete it. The result page and share card never show your face.

faq.q: Does it work on dusky and wheatish skin?
faq.a: Yes. All four seasons exist on every Indian skin depth. The tool looks at your undertone and clarity, not just how light or deep you are.
No. The colour season, the palette and the share card are free. A longer Style Report is optional.

intro: Most people shop colour by guesswork. You pick what looks good on the hanger, and then it looks flat on you. A colour season fixes that. It tells you which colours work with your skin, your hair and your eyes, so every shirt, kurta or dupatta you buy has a better chance of working. This tool reads one selfie and gives you your season in under a minute. It is built for Indian skin, from fair to deep, and it does not assume that one skin tone is better than another.
tips: Take the selfie near a window, facing the light, in the middle of the day.
Remove glasses and pull your hair back from your face.
Skip filters, beauty modes and heavy make-up.
Stand against a plain wall, not a coloured one.
honesty: We say how confident we are. If your light was poor, the result asks you to retake in daylight instead of guessing. You will never see a score that compares you with other people.
